# `Q-5-54` — `quarto-required` Admits Both Quarto 1 and Quarto 2

> The `quarto-required` range in `_quarto.yml` admits versions of both
> Quarto 1 and Quarto 2.

## What this means

`quarto-required` holds a version range. This one admits versions of
both Quarto 1 and Quarto 2, so it does not say which major version the
project is written for, and both will render it:

```yaml
quarto-required: ">=1.4"   # Q-5-54: 1.4, 1.9, 2.0 and 2.5 all qualify
```

Open ranges like this are common in Quarto 1 projects, which used them
to require a minimum Quarto 1 release.

## How to fix it

For a Quarto 2 project, write a range that admits Quarto 2 only:

```yaml
quarto-required: "^2"
```

For a Quarto 1 project, close the range below 2, for example
`"^1.7"` or `">=1.4 <2"`. Quarto 2 then reports [`Q-5-55`](Q-5-55.qmd)
instead, which says the project is a Quarto 1 project.

See [Declaring the Quarto version of a project](../../guides/projects/quarto-version.qmd).

## Related errors

- [`Q-5-53`](Q-5-53.qmd) — no `quarto-required` at all.
- [`Q-5-55`](Q-5-55.qmd) — the range admits no Quarto 2 version.
